Client FedGVI: generalized
variational updates combine a
divergence and a loss. Bounded-loss
influence claims require the

source's matching model and
regularity assumptions. KL/NLL with
beta zero recovers the project-local
Bayes update.

Heuristic server: robust_aggregate
discounts reports by disagreement
with the emerging consensus. At
robustness zero it exactly returns

log_linear_pool. Recovery only; no
transferred client theorem.

Variational server:
variational_aggregate alternates
consensus and raw effective-weight
updates on a stated objective.

Descent and raw-weight bounds do not
prove estimator B-robustness.

Choose one server rule after the
client update. Guarantees stay with
their own mathematical construction.
No universal robustness or source

protocol replication follows from
this diagram.
